turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. Compliments don't change a mark. I'm still waiting to hear whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own emails, Hale. I'm here about one student, and the clock is running. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. You're spending my twenty minutes on another family's problem, and I'm writing that down. Is anything about this on Owen's record right now?
